# Policymaker report: iteration 0000, pass 2 (review retry)

The pass-1 review `review-sources` (session #79) ran on codex/gpt-6.1-sol and ended `partial` with cause `session_budget`. It used 60/60 turns and 1,171,284 input tokens and wrote nothing: commit `c3afe18` is empty, and the frozen report `.github/loop/data/session-reports/79/ef14b1cf….json` has only the yaml header. The `sources` milestone therefore has still not been reviewed, and `bench-coverage` never started.

I replaced the orders in `.session/orders.json` (pass 2, `wake: true`):
1. **`review-sources-r2`** (reviewer, 100 turns / 120 min). This is the same review with tighter scope. The reviewer must create `.session/artifacts/review-sources.md` within 10 turns and append to it after each check, so a budget stop still leaves findings. The `sources` row comes first. The 0002 coverage implications come second and are optional, and any skipped part must be listed under `Not reviewed`. The reviewer must not walk `$LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT` file by file.
2. **`bench-coverage`** (benchmark, 100 turns / 120 min). This is unchanged in substance. It is blocked by `review-sources-r2` and receives `review-sources.md` as input.

Neither task marks a milestone reviewed or ready, so product implementation stays blocked per `docs/perpetua/evaluation.md`.

## Not measured / missing coverage
- Status of the milestones: `sources` prepared but not reviewed. `coverage`, `tasks`, `oracle`, `split`, `baseline` and `challenges` have not started (`benchmark/preparation-status.json`).
- Native LabVIEW reading: not executed. There are no withheld cases and no restricted storage. The `capability` proposal is still deferred until `split` is ordered.
- Model quality per quota: one data point only. gpt-6.1-sol spent its whole budget with nothing to show. That is not enough to reorder profiles yet.

## Discoveries
- Session #79 had a high input-to-output ratio (1.17M in / 8.7k out), which suggests broad reading rather than writing; see `.session/history/sessions/79/2bce2f58….md`.

## What next
- Saved work: `.session/orders.json` (2 tasks), plus a note in `policy/working-memory.md`.
- Next Policymaker: read `review-sources.md` and the `bench-coverage` report. If the reviewer stalls again on the same model, reorder the reviewer candidates in `execution/profiles.yml` (keep a model family different from the author's).
- Avoid repeating: reread loop-state/issue only once. The history for #79 is already summarized above.
